Overview

About RKVY RAFTAAR

RKVY RAFTAAR is a central sector scheme under the Rashtriya Krishi Vikas Yojana that promotes innovation and entrepreneurship in agriculture and allied sectors. Its Innovation and Agri-Entrepreneurship component funds startups through a network of agri-business incubators (R-ABIs) and knowledge partners.

Startups receive grant-in-aid of up to ₹5 Lakh at the idea or pre-seed stage and up to ₹25 Lakh at the seed stage, along with a residential incubation programme, mentoring, and linkages to markets, investors and research institutions.

Key benefits

  • Financial assistance of up to ₹25 Lakh for innovative agri-startups
  • Business growth support to scale the venture and reach new markets
  • Mentorship and incubation at RKVY agri-business incubators
  • Market linkages and exposure to buyers, investors and global opportunities
  • Support for R&D, prototyping and technology adoption
  • Creates rural jobs and drives sustainable rural development

Who is eligible

  • Startups working in agriculture and allied sectors
  • Registered in India as a private limited company, LLP, partnership or proprietorship
  • Innovative ideas, products or services with high impact potential
  • Early-stage to growth-stage enterprises
  • Individuals, FPOs, SHGs, farmers, entrepreneurs and companies can apply
  • Commitment to innovation, scalability and rural impact

Documents required

  • Incorporation or registration documents of the entity
  • Business plan with problem statement, solution and go-to-market
  • Prototype or product details and stage of development
  • Fund utilisation plan and projected impact
  • Founder KYC and team profiles
